conventions.convention: Relative entropy uses the natural logarithm, 0 log 0 = 0, and value +∞ when absolute continuity fails; AC is assumed for Radon–Nikodym existence.

Configurations are simple and locally finite in dimension d ≥ 1. Cells are i+[0,1)^d, with left-closed, right-open faces. Cell configurations use sorted-list Borel structures and the global sigma-algebra is generated by bounded-Borel counts.
Translation is T_xω(A)=ω(A−x); Q=Q_1 is the unit-intensity Poisson reference, while Q_λ has intensity λ>0.

The local-tame topology has domain stationary laws invariant under every real translation with finite expected unit-cell count. Its tests are all measurable local real functions satisfying |f| ≤ b(1+N_A) for a bounded support A.
Specific entropy uses origin-anchored half-open cubes [0,L)^d, real L→∞, and equals the supremum of normalized positive-integer cube entropies.

F_+ denotes cells preceding the reference cell in lexicographic order. Conditional-density convergence is directed over finite subsets of that past, and density convergence uses P_past⊗Q_cell while logarithmic convergence uses P.

The stated spatial information limit concerns positive-integer side lengths N and L¹(P) convergence. Constancy requires ergodicity under the full real translation group, with invariant events interpreted modulo null sets separately for each translation.
Entropy-level compactness and sequential compactness explicitly assume AC, the ultrafilter extension principle, DC, and HB.

load_bearing.statement: Assume AC. Relative entropy equals sup over bounded real measurable φ of P(φ)−log Q(e^φ), is nonnegative, and decreases under measurable push-forward. On standard-Borel product spaces, a joint law absolutely continuous with finite entropy against Q_X⊗Q_Y satisfies the displayed conditional chain rule. Conditional increments increase when a standard-Borel observation R is a measurable function of an observation S, under finite D(P_{S,Y}‖P_S⊗Q_Y).

Assume AC and d≥1. Construct simple finite configurations independently in each half-open unit cell, with Poisson(λ) counts and sorted independent uniform positions conditional on the count; extend the consistent finite cell laws to Q_λ on the product configuration sigma-algebra. Set Q=Q_1 and T_xω(A)=ω(A−x).

Assume AC, d≥1 and λ>0. Restrictions under Q_λ to pairwise disjoint bounded Borel sets are independent; their counts are Poisson with means λ|A|. Q_λ is invariant under every translation, its intensity measure is λ times Lebesgue measure, and E exp(aN_A)=exp(λ|A|(exp(a)−1)) for bounded Borel A and real a.

Assume AC and P∈P¹_stat(Ω). The limit I(P)=lim_{L→∞} L^(−d)D(P_[0,L)^d‖Q_[0,L)^d) exists in [0,+∞] and equals the supremum of the corresponding positive-integer cube ratios. If I(P)<∞, every bounded Borel restriction has finite relative entropy.
Assume AC, the ultrafilter extension principle, DC, and HB. For every finite c≥0, {P∈P¹_stat(Ω):I(P)≤c} is compact and sequentially compact in the local-tame topology.

Assume AC, P∈P¹_stat(Ω), and I(P)=γ<∞. Conditional cell log-density means g(A) are finite, nonnegative and increasing over finite lexicographic pasts, with supremum γ. Along every increasing finite exhaustion of the past, conditional densities converge in L¹(P_past⊗Q_cell) to the full-past joint density, and their logarithms converge in L¹(P), also in the stated directed uniform sense.

Assume AC, d≥1, P∈P¹_stat(Ω), full-real-translation ergodicity, and I(P)=γ<∞. For positive-integer N and h_N=dP_[0,N)^d/dQ_[0,N)^d, N^(−d)log h_N→γ in L¹(P). Without full-translation ergodicity the proof yields an invariant L¹(P) limit of mean γ, which need not be constant.

concerns.concern: Proof 3.1 introduces 'bounded Z_M' without defining Z_M, and 4.1 then asserts ||Z−Z_M||₁→0. Explicitly specifying the clipped truncations of Z would make these two uses checkable. The intended truncation is immediate and does not affect the theorem.

F2 and Verification 2.1 test the linear bound using support C_0, whereas the definition permits any bounded support A. The missing reduction is immediate: for any proposed A and b, put n distinct points in C_0 and no points elsewhere, so N_A≤n and n²>b(1+n). Alternatively justify F2 by deleting every point outside C_0 without changing the observable.

alerts.finding: The Definition says 'For a probability law C_L on finite configurations in Λ_L, define its empirical-field barycenter' by the displayed expectation formula 'for local tame f', without assuming E_C_L N<∞. Those signed expectations need not exist. Fix configurations η_n with n points and give them probabilities proportional to 1/n², n≥1. The local tame function f(ω)=(-1)^{N_Λ_L(ω)}N_Λ_L(ω) has value (-1)^n n on every translate of η_n's periodic continuation, since a half-open fundamental cube contains exactly n points. Both positive and negative expectation parts diverge. Thus the displayed formula is undefined on its stated domain, although a probability barycenter can still be defined using bounded measurable evaluations.

F4 attributes to thm-tdmath-spatial-mean-information the limit 'L^(−d) log(dP_Λ_L/dQ_Λ_L)→γ in L¹(P)'. The cited Statement explicitly restricts side length to 'an integer N≥1'. An all-real-side-length extension is not stated there. The extension can be obtained by comparing [0,L)^d with its floor-integer cube and using the conditional entropy and negative-log bounds, but that additional inference should be supplied or the citation should retain integer cubes.

seams_checked.note: Read both page summaries and checked the assigned item citations. This is contextual reading-order dependence: the spatial items do not invoke an ensembles-page item as a logical supplier. Their entropy and integration arguments use the explicitly declared local or published prerequisites.

Configuration, translation, unit-Poisson normalization, local-tame tests, entropy compactness and finite-region rules are used with compatible conventions. Lower semicontinuity of I follows from compact entropy sublevels in the Hausdorff local-tame topology. The periodic-law transfer explicitly reuses the compactness proof's marginal argument rather than claiming that its generally infinite-specific-entropy periodic laws belong to an entropy sublevel. However, continuum-variational-pressure F4 restates the integer-cube spatial information theorem for unrestricted L→∞; the citation-extension gap is recorded in alerts. The empirical-field barycenter's unrestricted signed-expectation domain is also recorded there.
